event_id.description: TRANSPORT_ONLY: Producer delivery id; inbox event key when quarantined

occurred_at.description: created_at of a new row: UTC ISO-8601; not in the future

source_version.description: ingest.key_map.source_version: Monotonic per external_key; lower = STALE_VERSION

external_key.description: ingest.key_map.external_key: Source business key; translated to a native id

organisation_key.description: TENANT_GUARD: Must equal the application's job organisation

from_status.description: application_status_event.from_reference_value_id: Must equal the application's status at that point (CHAIN_BREAK); null only for the first event

to_status.description: application_status_event.to_reference_value_id: Edge must exist in transition_rule (ILLEGAL_TRANSITION) for the actor's role (ACTOR_NOT_PERMITTED)

actor_key.description: application_status_event.actor_app_user_id: The application's own candidate, or the organisation's recruiter
